evidence: Beginning at North Taranaki Park Visitor Centre (North Egmont), the track can be walked in either direction.
The Pouākai Circuit begins on the Veronica Loop/Holly Hut Track, starting at North Egmont.
Follow the Ram Track uphill to return to North Egmont road end.

access_points.quote: Mangorei Road: Access is from the carpark at the top of Mangorei Road, off SH3, south of New Plymouth.

access_points.name: Dover Track

access_points.name: Ahukawakawa Track
access_points.quote: Ahukawakawa Track: Access is via the Ahukawakawa Track across the swamp from Holly Hut on the Around the Mountain Circuit.

doubts: Described anticlockwise-ish but text only says either direction, so direction null. North Egmont start has no road end feature (F1/F2 are on Egmont Road but not clearly the visitor centre), so ref is the place name T21. The 'lookout' exit point is the lookout ten minutes past the junction. Getting-there places listed as access points, not as separate starts (page says begins at North Egmont). Distance not given for whole circuit.
